    Have you paid National Insurance for at least 26 weeks (about 6 months)?

    This includes contributions paid by you or by an employer on your behalf. If you are not sure, choose ‘I am not sure’.

    Benefits you may be able to claim

    Based on your answers, you may be able to claim the benefits below. This is guidance only — the National Insurance and Social Security Service (NISSS) decides every claim.

    What happens next

    This check does not start a claim. To apply for any of these benefits:

    1. Gather the documents listed for each benefit.
    2. Contact the NISSS to confirm you qualify and to get the right claim form.
    3. Submit your claim to the NISSS. They will tell you their decision.

    Visit the NISSS website for office locations and contact details.
